mistake_reason: At step 20, the orchestrator exhibited Loss of Conversation History (FM-1.4) by unexpectedly discarding previously computed results and prior instructions. Despite earlier verified totals showing Wharvton’s combined sales were higher ($402,780 vs $381,520), the orchestrator reset context, claimed no attachment was present, and reverted to a fresh interaction state. It then directed a guess based on generic assumptions, forcing the final answer to Algrimand and disregarding all tool outputs and established conclusions.
